$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{a\cdot b}{|\,b\,|} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{\sqrt{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{(\sqrt{6})(4)+(2)(-2)+(-1)(-3)}{\sqrt{{4}^{2}+(-2)^{2}+(-3)^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{4\sqrt{6}-4+3}{\sqrt{29}} \\  & =\frac{-1+4\sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{29}}.\end{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{b\cdot a}{|\,a\,|} \\  & =\frac{{b}_{x}{a}_{x}+{b}_{y}{a}_{y}+{b}_{z}{a}_{z}}{\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{-1+4\sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{(\sqrt{6})^{2}+{2}^{2}+(-1)^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{-1+4\sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{11}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a-{\text{comp}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{-1+4\sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{29}}-\frac{-1+4\sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{11}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{11}\left(-1+4\sqrt{6}\right)-\sqrt{29}\left(-1+4\sqrt{6}\right)}{\sqrt{319}}.\end{aligned}

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{b\cdot a}{|\,a\,|} \\  & =\frac{{b}_{x}{a}_{x}+{b}_{y}{a}_{y}+{b}_{z}{a}_{z}}{\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{(-\sqrt{3})^{2}+(-\sqrt{6})^{2}+{1}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{10}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a-{\text{comp}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{8}}-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{10}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{30}-2\sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{80}}.\end{aligned}
